points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in interpreting complex policy documents.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for clinical criteria evaluation.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring trusted outputs for high-stakes decision logic.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster, reliable data extraction from unstructured records.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, improving user experience while maintaining data integrity.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable NLP solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for policy translation and evaluation.
